hero.hive_desc: Hive is the comprehensive ERP solution built for scalable businesses in Ethiopia. Connect your Finance, HR, and Supply Chain with local tax and banking integrations.

modules.desc: Stop switching between ten different spreadsheets. Hive centralizes every aspect of your Ethiopian business operations into one seamless dashboard.
modules.finance_desc: Automated ERCA tax compliance, local bank API integrations for immediate reconciliation, and multi-currency ledger management (ETB/USD).
modules.inventory_desc: Multi-branch stock syncing, automated reorder triggers, and warehouse routing.

fintech.desc: We understand the Ethiopian financial landscape. Hive bridges the gap between your operational ERP and localized payment processors.

mobility.desc: Expand beyond basic tracking. Hive features advanced integration capabilities for municipalities, transit authorities, and logistics giants.
mobility.traffic_desc: Automate toll collection and traffic violation processing via direct API integration with Telebirr and local transit databases.
mobility.ev_desc: Manage an Electric Vehicle fleet with specialized dashboard modules tracking battery health, charging node status, and route optimization.

hr.title: Ethiopian Payroll & Pension
hr.desc: Managing payroll shouldn't require a master's in tax law. Hive automatically handles ERCA tax tables and POESSA pension contributions for all your employees.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does Hive ERP work during internet outages?
faq.a1: Yes. Our mobile apps and POS systems feature offline-sync. They store data locally and automatically push to the central cloud once connection is restored.
faq.q2: Is our corporate data stored locally in Ethiopia?
faq.a2: We offer hybrid deployments. You can choose to host your Node on our secure AWS infrastructure, or deploy an On-Premise instance directly within your local data center for strict INSA compliance.
faq.q3: Can we integrate existing legacy software?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Hive comes with a comprehensive REST API and webhooks, allowing Techive Technology Solutions to build custom bridges to your existing software.
faq.q4: How does the multi-tenant architecture work?
faq.a4: Each company gets its own isolated database schema. This guarantees zero data-bleed between clients while allowing us to push instantaneous system updates to everyone simultaneously.
